adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a writable endpoint `put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"` and an Ember adapter/controller for `embedding`. In `app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb`, `update` does not read or persist any params; it simply re-renders the current `@embedding` OpenStruct (which is re-fetched each request from `EmbeddableHost.all.order(:host)`). On the client side, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines `saveChanges()` that calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, which would hit that PUT endpoint but cannot change server state. This is verifiably dead/no-op API surface, but it doesn’t clearly break existing functionality in the shown templates (no save button wired to `saveChanges` in `embedding.hbs`), so it’s more of an unnecessary/incomplete endpoint than a correctness bug.
